items.title: Terminal Maps
items.summary: Find gates, security, and amenities across the terminal.
items.body: Use terminal maps to locate your gate, security checkpoints, washrooms, and transfer routes. Allow extra walking time between piers, especially when connecting internationally.

items.title: Custom and Immigration
items.summary: Arrival, declaration, and border processing tips.
items.body: Have your passport and any required travel documents ready before landing. Follow signs for customs and immigration, use Primary Inspection Kiosks when available, and declare restricted goods as required.

items.title: Shop, Dine and Services
items.summary: Dining, retail, lounges, and passenger services.
items.body: Explore airside dining and retail after security, including local favourites and duty-free for international departures. Currency exchange, ATMs, and family facilities are signed throughout the terminal.

items.title: Parking
items.body: Parkades connect to the terminal via covered walkways. Economy lots offer shuttle service for longer stays. Canada Line SkyTrain is often the fastest way downtown—pre-book parking online during peak season.
